Description: Seoul Bike Sharing Demand Analysis: Impact of Time and Weather on Hourly Bike Rentals
Environmental / Urban Mobility (Traffic Pattern Analysis)

To analyze how time (hour, day, month, season, holidays) and weather (temperature, humidity, rainfall, snowfall, wind speed) affect hourly bike rentals in Seoul, and to find peak demand patterns that help plan bike availability.

End-to-end exploratory data analysis in Python: data loading, cleaning, derived features, EDA, 10+ visualizations, and at least 5 insights with recommendations. No deployment or live system is included.
Course instructor (evaluation), bike-sharing operators and city planners (as example stakeholders of the insights)
